name: hud_sensor_set_bounds
description: HudSensorTracker::SetBounds copies the outer rect, expands the optional inner rect, and caches the outer midpoint.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x4166e0 returns immediately for a null outer rect; otherwise it copies the outer rect, expands an optional inner rect by one pixel on each side or zeros it when absent, and caches signed midpoint coordinates.
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4166e0 has no warnings or tags and shows the same outer/inner rect and midpoint behavior.
The native hud_sensor_map_bounds_and_save_state_smoke verifies the copied outer rect, expanded inner rect, and cached map overlay center.
